newsitem.title: LEBANON: Bank of Lebanon forex reserves up in mid-July.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Lebanon forex reserves up in mid-July.

text.p: The Bank of Lebanon's gross foreign exchange reserves rose by $20.82 million in the first half of July to reach $6,551 million, according to central bank figures published in newspapers.
Gross reserves had risen $34.07 million in the second half of June to hit $6,530 million.
Gross reserves include commercial banks' net foreign exchange deposits with the central bank.
The statement did not give the bank's net reserves but banking sources said they dropped by $50 million to $4,950 million.
They stood at $4,015 million at the end of 1996 compared with $2,858 million a year earlier.
